reason: शृङ्गवेरपुर is Gita Press's consistent spelling of the town throughout the book (8 places), a known variant of Śṛṅgiberapura.
तदा 'then' is a valid adverb fitting the sense and metre equally well as तथा.
पुमासं is not a form; the accusative of पुंस् is पुमांसम्, with the anusvāra dropped in print.
Gita Press writes पत्रिन् everywhere else in the book, so the doubled त् is a slip.
अङ्गलीयक is not a word; the ु of अङ्गुलीयक (ring), which Gita Press prints elsewhere, was dropped.
गीति (f., song) is a valid word; सर्वगीतिषु कोविदौ 'skilled in all songs' makes good sense.
The stray े on की is an extra sign that makes a non-word.
काम्बोज is the standard spelling of the Kamboja country; the others' काम्भोज is the variant.
The verse lists the three classes of elephants (भद्र, मन्द्र, मृग) and their mixtures, so मद्रैः is a slip for मन्द्रैः.
The king observes the people through spies, so the active middle participle अवेक्षमाणः is required (Gita Press's form elsewhere); passive अवेक्ष्यमाणः 'being observed' is wrong here.
भगवन् before त् correctly becomes भगवंस्त्- by sandhi (8.3.7), so भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन is the regular form.
The ु of श्रुत्वा was dropped, giving a non-word.
मानुष्य (n., human state/world) is a valid word; मानुष्ये 'in the human condition' fits the sense and metre.
पौरजानपदान् as a dvandva compound is valid and means the same as the separate पौराञ्जानपदान्.
राजार्षि is not a word; the compound is राजर्षि.
ससुखम् 'happily' (sa + sukha, adverbial) is a valid form with the same metre and sense as सुसुखम्.
यक्षिणी is a valid synonym of यक्षी and keeps the pāda at 8 syllables (कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य / यक्षिणी कामरूपिणी).
Gita Press spells Viśvāmitra's name कौशिक everywhere else, so स is a slip.
ववनम् is not a word; the formula is इदं वचनमब्रवीत्.
The word is नैराश्य, which is Gita Press's spelling everywhere else; नैरास्य is a misspelling.
सार्चिमाली (sa + arci + mālin) is a possible name form of this astra, and nothing settles it against सार्चिर्माली; the metre is the same.
With युवाम्, a second-person dual imperative (रक्षतम्) is required; रक्षताम् is third person.
अवशीर्यत (passive imperfect of शॄ, 'was dispersed/shattered all around') is a valid form that makes sense here.
The subject is singular (Asamañja) and the clause needs the present participle प्रहसन्; प्राहसन् is a third-person plural imperfect.
अयं needs a nominative noun, and यज्ञहनः (genitive/ablative of यज्ञहन्) does not fit; यज्ञहरः 'stealer of our sacrifice' matches the horse being carried off.
समुपाक्रान्ताः (sam-upa-ā-√kram, 'having approached') is a valid form with the same metre and sense.
The pāda has only 7 syllables and अनिलोपम् is not a form; the accusative is अनिलोपमम्.
तदद्भुतमिमं … गङ्गावतरमुत्तमम् ('that wonder, this excellent descent of Gaṅgā') is grammatical, with इमम् agreeing with the masculine अवतरम्.
उद्भूतम् 'risen up' is a valid participle that fits the description of the river's course.
The sage is जह्नु, as Gita Press prints in the same sarga (verses 35 and 38), so र is a slip for न.
तथागच्छद् देवलोकम् is the regular sandhi of -त् before द्.
मारीचः कश्यपः ('Kaśyapa, son of Marīci') is a valid way to name the sage, as is काश्यप.
सुरोष 'very angry' is a valid word that Monier-Williams cites from the Rāmāyaṇa.
वातभक्षा 'living on air' is a valid synonym of वायुभक्षा.
कामधुग् before द् is the correct voiced final; the difference is sandhi only.
हैरण्यकक्ष ('with golden girths'), with the compound-final short form of कक्षा, is acceptable and the metre is identical.
द्रंष्ट्र is not a word; the stray ् र makes it a misspelling of दंष्ट्रा (fang).
Gita Press prints both names with -ष्पन्द (from स्पन्द), हविष्पन्दो मधुष्पन्दो, a name form known to the tradition; it is consistent in the verse.
अनुपूर्वेण 'in due order' is a valid synonym of आनुपूर्व्येण.
नान्यच्छरणम् (अन्यत् agreeing with neuter शरणम्) is valid sandhi and grammar.
चाण्डाल is a valid, common spelling of चण्डाल.
रोषतः 'from anger' (ablative -तस्) is valid and fits the sense.
अभ्यगच्छन् (abhi + agacchan, imperfect) is a valid form; अभ्यागच्छन् adds आ but means the same.
कन्दर्पदर्पवशगः 'under the sway of Kandarpa's pride' is valid and the pāda has 8 syllables.
यदि मे भगवन् आह (vocative with an honorific third-person verb) is acceptable, and nothing settles it against भगवानाह.
आगत्य and आगम्य are both valid gerunds of आ-√गम्.
दीर्घायुर्ऋषिः is the regular sandhi of -उः before a vowel.
अन्वयात् (anu + ayāt, imperfect of √या) 'followed' is a valid form.
तथा and तदा are both valid here and leave the metre the same.
The noun 'royal tent' is the feminine उपकार्या (as Gita Press prints elsewhere), so the accusative is उपकार्याम्; the dropped ा gives a non-noun.
अनुरुध्यामहे (anu-√rudh, class 4, middle) is a valid form.
जामदग्नय is not a word and gives the pāda 9 syllables; the patronymic is जामदग्न्यः.
विकल 'agitated, distressed' is a valid word that fits the father's state.
सदिता is not a word; the sense is भर्तृभिः सहिताः 'together with their husbands'.
कदाचित् 'at some time' is valid and makes good sense.
दुर्वच 'speaking ill' (mfn.) is valid, and न दुर्वचः describes Rāma correctly.
निस्तन्द्रीः keeps the ī-stem nominative of तन्द्री, which Monier-Williams records as ifc. nom. ˚द्रीस् in the epics.
सत्संग्रहानुग्रहणे 'in gathering and favouring the good' is a valid compound.
अनुकम्पक 'compassionate' is a valid synonym of अनुकम्पन.
स्वर and स्वन are synonyms; both are valid.
विश्राम and विश्रम are both valid words for 'rest'.
प्रातः 'tomorrow morning' is valid and fits the announcement of the consecration.
आगत्य and आगम्य are both valid gerunds.
Monier-Williams records तालापचर ('dancer') citing exactly this verse (R. ii, 3, 17).
अङ्गन 'courtyard' is a valid spelling (Monier-Williams), used by Gita Press here.
अभ्युद्यत 'raised, made ready' is a valid participle fitting the seat.
तथा + आसनवरम् is valid sandhi and makes sense.
विभ्राजिता 'made resplendent', agreeing with सा सभा, is valid.
निर्णीतः 'determined (to be)' with इति is valid and makes sense.
गुणवानिति, with निर्णीतः, is a valid construction.
आगत्य is a valid synonym of अभ्येत्य.
दारुणग्रहैः, a karmadhāraya compound, is valid.
The sense 'Sītā had been brought' needs the causative participle आनायिता; आनयिता is an agent noun and does not fit.
यौवराज्येऽभिषेचनम् 'consecration to the heir-apparency' (locative) is valid.
इक्ष्वाकुराजश्रीः 'the royal fortune of the Ikṣvākus' is valid.
सस्त्रीबालाकुलः 'crowded with women and children' is valid and fits जनः.
आकाङ्क्षन् as an imperfect plural with the collective जनः (agreement by sense) is acceptable in the epic.
तथा and तदा are both valid here.

युताम् 'joined with' is a valid synonym of वृताम्.
ब्रह्मघोषनिनादिताम् 'resounding with Vedic chant' is valid.
अङ्गेन 'with/against the body' is a valid reading that makes sense with परिधृतः.
The gerund of अभि + असूय is अभ्यसूय; the doubled य् makes a non-form.
किमर्थम् 'why' is valid and makes good sense.
प्रेष्यत्वं हि गमिष्यति is valid and makes an 8-syllable pāda.
The pāda यौवराज्ये भरतं has only 7 syllables; the च that both other editions have restores the metre.
अद्य 'today' is a valid word; the syllable count of this pāda is the same as with एव.
With मा स्म, the second-person optative middle is प्रत्युदीक्षेथाः (written -था before म); प्रत्युदीक्षेया is not a form.
रामप्रव्रजनम् 'Rāma's going into exile' is a valid noun stating the demand.
संगृहीत is a valid synonym of सुगृहीत.
नावजानामि 'I do not disregard' is valid and makes sense.
निर्मृष्ट 'polished, smooth' is valid as praise.
भोजनैः is a valid word in the list of things she rejects.
मां … गताम् इतः 'me gone hence to Yama's realm' needs the accusative गताम्; the nominative गता does not agree with मां, so भ is a slip for म.
वापीभिरुपशोभितम् is valid (the others merely add च).
